abaci: plural of abacus: frames with sliding beads used for counting.
abettal: the act of abetting; encouragement or help given to a wrongdoer.
aboil: boiling; in a state of agitation or excitement.
achoo: used to represent the sound of a sneeze.
agendum: an item of business to be considered; singular of agenda.
alfa: a code word representing the letter A in radio communication.
anagramming: rearranging the letters of a word or phrase to make another.
antiaging: intended to prevent or slow the visible effects of growing older.
aortal: relating to the aorta, the main artery leaving the heart.
appetize: to give an appetite to; to whet the appetite.
arability: the quality of being arable, or fit for growing crops.
asea: at sea; also, bewildered or at a loss.
athrob: throbbing; pulsing with feeling or sound.
atonally: in a manner without a musical key or tonal centre.
banc: the bench of a court; used of a court sitting in full session.
barback: an assistant to a bartender, who restocks and fetches supplies.
biradial: having two radial parts or axes of symmetry.
blabby: inclined to talk too much or give away secrets.
bolded: made bold, as of text set in heavier type.
bottleful: as much as a bottle will hold.
bowwow: used to represent the barking of a dog; informally, a dog.
cannellini: a large white Italian kidney bean.
canopic: denoting an ancient Egyptian jar holding the organs of an embalmed body.
cartway: a way or track wide enough for a cart.
clodding: throwing clods of earth; forming into clods.
codevelop: to develop jointly with another party.
coldcock: to knock someone unconscious, especially with a sudden blow.
coldcocked: knocked unconscious with a sudden blow.
cooldown: a period of gentle activity after exercise; a required wait before reuse.
cotenant: a person who holds a tenancy jointly with another.
crog: to carry a passenger on a bicycle; a ride so given.
cuckooed: repeated monotonously, in the manner of a cuckoo's call.
dandily: in a fine or excellent manner.
didact: a person who teaches, especially in a moralizing way.
dillydally: to waste time through aimless wandering or indecision.
drib: a small or trifling amount; a drop.
durag: a close-fitting cloth tied over the head, worn to hold a hairstyle.
electee: a person who has been elected.
emaciate: to make abnormally thin or weak, especially through hunger or illness.
flipflop: an abrupt reversal of policy or opinion; a backless rubber sandal.
flipflopping: reversing one's position abruptly and repeatedly.
folic: denoting folic acid, a B vitamin found in leafy greens and liver.
formic: denoting formic acid, the sharp-smelling acid present in ant venom.
gayly: in a cheerful or lively manner.
gelee: a jelly, especially a cosmetic or culinary preparation with a jelly texture.
goggly: bulging or rolling, as of the eyes.
hatha: denoting a form of yoga based on physical postures and breath control.
headpin: the front pin in a triangular arrangement of bowling pins.
hipline: the line or measurement round the hips.
hoorah: used to express joy or approval; a cheer.
kays: plural of kay, the letter K.
keto: denoting a very low-carbohydrate diet that induces ketosis.
lapboard: a flat board held on the lap to serve as a desk or table.
libelee: the party against whom a libel suit is brought.
limbic: relating to the limbic system of the brain, which governs emotion.
littleneck: a small quahog clam, eaten raw or steamed.
logroll: to trade political favours so as to get one another's bills passed.
malic: denoting malic acid, the acid responsible for the tartness of apples.
mancala: a board game played by sowing seeds or stones round a row of pits.
matchmake: to bring people together as a couple, or to arrange a contest.
megahit: an enormously successful film, record, or product.
megaplex: a very large cinema complex with many screens.
microcrack: a very fine crack in a material.
micromini: an extremely short skirt or dress.
mirin: a sweet Japanese rice wine used in cooking.
nametag: a badge showing the wearer's name.
netty: resembling a net; having a network of markings.
nonbinding: not imposing a legal or contractual obligation.
nondominant: not dominant, as of the hand a person writes with less readily.
nonillion: a thousand octillion, written as one followed by thirty zeros.
nonlocal: not local; belonging to or coming from elsewhere.
nonpolar: having no electrical polarity, as of a molecule.
nonvocal: not vocal; without voice or singing.
notionality: the quality of being notional or existing only in the mind.
nucleic: denoting nucleic acids such as DNA and RNA, found in living cells.
nunchuck: one of a pair of hardwood sticks joined by a chain, used as a weapon.
octillion: a thousand septillion, written as one followed by twenty-seven zeros.
offtrack: away from a racecourse, as of betting placed elsewhere.
oleic: denoting oleic acid, the chief fatty acid in olive oil.
onlay: a layer applied to a surface; a dental restoration bonded onto a tooth.
outduel: to defeat in a contest between two opponents.
outdueled: defeated in a contest between two opponents.
pampa: a vast treeless plain of South America.
pantie: relating to panties, as in pantie girdle; a single such garment.
peapod: the seed case of the pea plant.
pend: to await settlement; to remain undecided.
plena: plural of plenum, a full assembly or a space filled with matter.
puppylike: resembling a puppy, especially in eagerness or affection.
ratatat: used to represent a rapid knocking or drumming sound.
rolltop: denoting a desk with a flexible slatted cover that rolls back.
tagalong: a person who follows others without being invited.
takeback: a withdrawal of something said or offered; a retraction.
tantara: a blast or fanfare on a trumpet or horn.
taxability: the quality of being liable to tax.
tinct: a tinge of colour; to tint.
tock: the hollow sound made by a clock, following the tick.
tubeful: as much as a tube will hold.
ultima: the final syllable of a word.
unapt: not appropriate; not apt or inclined.
unarm: to disarm; to remove armour or weapons.
unbag: to take out of a bag.
unclutch: to release from a grip or from the clutch.
uncock: to release the cocked hammer of a firearm safely.
uncocked: released from the cocked position, as of a firearm's hammer.
uncuffed: freed from handcuffs; not wearing handcuffs.
undimmed: not dimmed; still bright or undiminished.
unglue: to separate something that has been glued.
unjam: to free from a jam or blockage.
unjamming: freeing from a jam or blockage.
unlet: not rented out, as of a property.
unmount: to remove from a mount; to make a mounted drive inaccessible.
unpen: to release from a pen or enclosure.
unpenned: released from a pen; also, not written down.
unpenning: releasing from a pen or enclosure.
unpile: to take off a pile; to remove from a heap.
untune: to put out of tune; to disturb the order of.
vulvae: plural of vulva, the external female genitals.
woohoo: used to express exuberance or delight.
workwoman: a woman who works, especially with her hands; a female worker.
yardwork: work done in a garden or yard, such as mowing and weeding.
yente: a gossip or busybody; a matchmaker.
zigzaggy: having a zigzag form; full of sharp alternating turns.
